summary_1line: The sage Poulastya visits King Arjuna and respectfully requests the release of his captured descendant Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant sage Poulastya strides into the city of Mahishmati like the rising sun while citizens gaze in awe.
King Arjuna bows with joined palms before the glowing ascetic Poulastya as priests bring ritual offerings of arghya and madhuparka.
